title: alchemilla hoppeana subsp. pallens
intro: Alchemilla hoppeana subsp. pallens, commonly known as mountain lady's mantle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Alchemilla hoppeana subsp. pallens include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include acting as a vulnerary, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
